object: Ordered all-dirty product-shear trees formed from the PR673 multiway echo, under a caller-specified bound on simultaneously borrowed arrays.
method: Exact dynamic programming over arbitrary positive contiguous child partitions and node fanouts, with the complete 2/4/2 child-call multiplicities and k-1 local arrays. Independent small-domain enumeration and symbolic noncommutative restoration checks.
seed_diversification: The main generic instance has 50 ordered factors. The method changes the search class, rather than repeating balanced ternary placement.
domain: Factor counts 1 through 64, scratch budgets 0 through 8; independent exhaustive tree enumeration in a smaller declared domain.
stopping_rule: One deterministic optimum table for this grammar and budget domain, an executable schedule, complete cost recurrence, and negative controls; no search for a new kappa.
expected_deliverable: Scoped interface construction and exact space/call tradeoff certificate; no multiplication bound claim.
time_allocation: 60-minute target; orientation at most 12 minutes, final 15 minutes reserved for verification and handoff.

result.status: research note and independent verification; no new kappa
result.theorem: Every ordered echo tree using at most s dirty arrays has N >= 2^(s+1)*n - 4^s; equality is attained for s>=2 and 3*2^(s-2)<=n<=2^s.
result.example: F(50,6)=2304, versus 2752 in the pinned balanced binary schedule, with no additional array.
result.distinctness: Concurrent PR758 already supplies all-arity optimization. The distinct result is the analytic scratch-dependent bound and explicit attaining family; optimizer minima are independent corroboration.
result.complete_search_domain: All 576 cells n=1..64, s=0..8; 255 feasible witnesses; exact recurrence, no stochastic cutoff.
